meta.title: What Would You Like to Eat, My Dear? – A Wheel of Your Favorite Foods
meta.description: Spin the wheel of fortune to discover what you're craving, then find highly rated restaurants nearby where we can enjoy a lovely meal together.

intro.message: Setting out all your favourite dishes, ready for you to take your pick…

header.tagline: May we stay together for a long, long time, sharing countless delicious meals and making beautiful memories along the way.

hero.label: Vietnamese food wheel
hero.lede: So you don't have to wonder, just give the wheel a spin — and I'll take you anywhere you'd like to go.

wheel.ring: SPIN IT • PICK A DISH • WHAT TO EAT •
wheel.swipeHint: Tap or swipe sideways to spin
wheel.notEnough: You need at least 2 active dishes to spin.
wheel.tapToSpin: Tap SPIN or drag the wheel and let go

items.title: Spin
items.text: Tap the button or swipe the wheel. Every spin is truly random.

items.title: Find
items.text: Look up highly rated, much-reviewed places on Google Maps around where we are.

items.title: Go
items.text: One tap opens directions from where we are to the place.

result.label: Result
result.nearbyHint: High rating · many reviews · close by
result.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Allow location access to see places near us.
result.noPlaces: No matching places found nearby yet.
result.error: Couldn't load places. Please try again.
result.noApiKey: Google Maps API key isn't configured — search directly on Google Maps instead.
result.consentBody: To find places near you we need your device's precise location — this is sensitive personal data. It's used only for this search, sent to Google Maps Platform to get the list of places, and not stored. You can withdraw consent at any time.
result.consentDecline: No, I'll search Google Maps myself

manage.label: Manage
manage.title: The menu
manage.subtitle: Add new dishes or switch one off to hide it from the wheel.
manage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.
manage.errorName: Please enter a dish name (max 40 characters).
manage.errorDuplicate: This dish is already on the list.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.body: This site uses strictly necessary cookies and browser storage (language, remembering this choice, image caching) to work. Remembering sound and using your location to find places are only on if you agree — you can change your mind any time.
consent.learnMore: How this site uses cookies & data
consent.terms: I accept the {terms} and have read the {privacy}.
consent.needTerms: Please tick to accept the Terms to continue.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.desc: Language, your consent choice, caching and security. Never used for tracking or ads.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.desc: Remember your sound on/off choice and the background-music album on this device.

location.title: Location
location.desc: Use your current location (once, not stored) to find places near you. Your browser will still ask for permission.

music.title: Background music
music.error: Couldn't load the music — tap to retry
